## Repository Scope and Entry Points
Strands Agents is a monorepo for model-driven AI-agent SDKs in Python and TypeScript, plus an MCP documentation server, developer CLI, documentation site, and AWS-backed integration-test infrastructure. Public SDK entry points are `strands-py/src/strands/__init__.py` and `strands-ts/src/index.ts` (with Node-specific exports in `strands-ts/src/index.node.ts`). The central invocation APIs are `strands-py/src/strands/agent/agent.py` and `strands-ts/src/agent/agent.ts`.

## Agent Execution Core
Each SDK centers on an `Agent` that owns prompt/conversation state, a model, tools, and lifecycle controls. Agent invocation drives an iterative model/tool loop, producing results and streamed events. Python orchestration is split between `strands-py/src/strands/agent/agent.py`, `strands-py/src/strands/event_loop/event_loop.py`, and `strands-py/src/strands/event_loop/streaming.py`; TypeScript consolidates core invocation in `strands-ts/src/agent/agent.ts` with tool dispatch in `strands-ts/src/agent/tool-caller.ts`.

## Model Provider Boundary
A shared model abstraction isolates agent logic from LLM transports, schemas, streaming, retries, and provider-specific error behavior. Python implementations include Bedrock, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, and local/aggregator providers under `strands-py/src/strands/models/model.py`, `strands-py/src/strands/models/bedrock.py`, and `strands-py/src/strands/models/openai.py`. TypeScript counterparts are `strands-ts/src/models/model.ts`, `strands-ts/src/models/bedrock.ts`, and `strands-ts/src/models/openai/model.ts`. Amazon Bedrock is the default; external services include AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and others through adapters.

## Tools, MCP, and Execution Safety
Models select registered tool schemas; executors validate and invoke them sequentially or concurrently, returning results to the loop. Core Python paths are `strands-py/src/strands/tools/registry.py`, `strands-py/src/strands/tools/executors/concurrent.py`, and `strands-py/src/strands/tools/mcp/mcp_client.py`; TypeScript paths are `strands-ts/src/registry/tool-registry.ts`, `strands-ts/src/tools/executors/concurrent.ts`, and `strands-ts/src/mcp/client.ts`. Sandboxes separate tool execution from host environments using local POSIX, Docker, or SSH implementations: `strands-py/src/strands/sandbox/docker.py` and `strands-ts/src/sandbox/docker.ts`.

## Extensibility, Control, and State
Hooks, middleware, plugins, and interventions provide interception boundaries around agent/model/tool stages for logging, authorization, human approval, steering, and cancellation. Key paths are `strands-py/src/strands/_middleware/stages.py`, `strands-py/src/strands/interventions/registry.py`, `strands-ts/src/middleware/stages.ts`, and `strands-ts/src/interventions/handler.ts`. Conversation/context managers constrain token growth, while session, storage, and memory layers persist or retrieve state; e.g., `strands-py/src/strands/agent/conversation_manager/conversation_manager.py`, `strands-py/src/strands/memory/memory_manager.py`, `strands-ts/src/session/session-manager.ts`, and `strands-ts/src/storage/s3-storage.ts`. Durable integrations include filesystem and Amazon S3; Bedrock Knowledge Bases are vended memory stores.

## Multi-Agent, Observability, and Streaming
Agents can compose as tools or execute through graph, swarm, and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols. Primary implementations are `strands-py/src/strands/multiagent/graph.py`, `strands-py/src/strands/multiagent/a2a/server.py`, `strands-ts/src/multiagent/graph.ts`, and `strands-ts/src/a2a/express-server.ts`. Telemetry traces and metrics agent decisions and operations through `strands-py/src/strands/telemetry/tracer.py` and `strands-ts/src/telemetry/tracer.ts`. Python additionally exposes experimental bidirectional text/audio agents for Gemini Live, Nova Sonic, and OpenAI Realtime under `strands-py/src/strands/experimental/bidi/agent/agent.py`.

## Supporting Products and Delivery
`strands-mcp/src/strands_mcp_server/__main__.py` starts a Python MCP server that fetches, processes, indexes, caches, and serves project documentation. `strandly/src/cli.ts` is the workspace developer CLI. The Astro documentation application is rooted at `site/src/pages/index.astro`, content is defined in `site/src/content.config.ts`, and custom rendering/routing resides in `site/src/route-middleware.ts`. GitHub Actions package, test, release, and deploy the SDKs and site; AWS CDK integration-test resources are defined by `test-infra/bin/test-infra.ts` and `test-infra/lib/stacks/test-infra-stack.ts`.
